historical_growth.notes: FCF is volatile due to acquisition timing and CapEx lumps; equity CAGR most reliable for acquisition-driven grower. 3-yr shows acceleration (25.9%) but using more conservative 5-yr figure.

base.notes: Base assumes continued acquisitions at historical pace, occupancy gains to 85%, skilled mix improvement. Growth decelerates from 22% equity CAGR toward terminal. FCF margin reflects FY2025 level (7.3% of revenue).

bull.notes: Bull case: aggressive acquisition pace with $1B+ capital deployed, occupancy to 87%+, margin expansion from integration success, skilled mix to 33%+, REIT rental income grows 20%+. Lower WACC reflects execution de-risking.

bear.notes: Bear case: OBBB Medicaid cuts hit in FY2030, labor inflation 8%+ outpaces 3% reimbursement, acquisition integration stumbles, state budget crises reduce rates, MA penetration compresses margins, occupancy stalls at 83%.

sensitivity.notes: Matrix shows intrinsic value across WACC (8-12%) and terminal growth (2-4%). Current price of $176.59 implies WACC of ~9.25% and terminal growth of ~2.75%.

probability_weighted.notes: Higher bull weight (30%) reflects strong execution track record, visible acquisition pipeline, and demographic tailwinds. Bear weight (25%) accounts for Medicaid policy risk and labor inflation.

analyst_notes.valuation_summary: ENSG trades at $176.59, above the base case IV of $144.04 but below bull case of $266.17. Probability-weighted IV of $159.06 suggests modest overvaluation at current levels. The market is pricing in continued strong execution and multiple expansion. Stock trades at ~23x FY2026 guided EPS of $7.51 vs 5-yr avg of ~15x.
key_value_drivers: Acquisition execution: 46 facilities added in 2025, with $1B+ available capital for continued M&A. Historical playbook improves EBITDAR from 13.2% to 18.8% by month 45.
Occupancy recovery: Same-facility occupancy improved 2.5pp to 82.9% in FY2025. Path to 85%+ occupancy represents significant earnings upside.
Skilled mix: Improved to 30.7% of days (49.4% of revenue) in FY2025. Continued shift to higher-acuity patients drives margin expansion.
Standard Bearer REIT: $1.7B real estate portfolio (vs $3.6B market cap) provides hidden asset value and rental income growth potential.
Quality metrics: 6.8% better overall star ratings vs national average positions company for value-based care upside.
key_risks: OBBB Medicaid cuts: Federal contribution reductions starting FY2030, state-directed payment caps, and provider tax restrictions threaten 44.6% of revenue.
Labor inflation: Healthcare worker shortage is structural. 60% of expenses are payroll-related and wage inflation may outpace 3.2% reimbursement increases.
Acquisition pace: 46 facilities in 2025 requires flawless integration execution. Each deal depresses margins for 12-18 months.
Valuation risk: At 23x forward P/E (vs 15x historical), multiple compression on any execution stumble or guidance miss could be severe.
State budget pressures: California deficit, Colorado rate stagnation signal Medicaid reimbursement risk ahead.
analyst_notes.recommendation: HOLD - ENSG has excellent fundamentals (22% equity CAGR, proven acquisition model, demographic tailwinds) but current valuation at $176.59 leaves limited margin of safety. Base case IV of $144.04 suggests -18% downside, while bull case of $266.17 offers +51% upside. Better entry around $120-140 (15-20% pullback) would provide 15%+ CAGR potential with margin of safety. For investors already holding, the strong execution track record and visible growth runway justify continued ownership, but new positions should wait for better entry.
